mapper.select: select max(sa.answer_id) from biz_student_answer sa where sa.student_answer = #{resource}
select max(sa.answer_id) from biz_student_answer sa where sa.preview_path = #{resource}

select max(v.source_answer_id) from biz_practical_attachment attachment inner join biz_practical_submission_version v on v.version_id = attachment.version_id where v.source_answer_id is not null and attachment.resource_path = #{resource}

select max(v.source_answer_id) from biz_practical_attachment attachment inner join biz_practical_submission_version v on v.version_id = attachment.version_id where v.source_answer_id is not null and attachment.preview_path = #{resource}

select max(v.source_answer_id) from biz_practical_attachment attachment inner join biz_practical_submission_version v on v.version_id = attachment.version_id where v.source_answer_id is not null and JSON_CONTAINS(attachment.normalized_pages_json, JSON_QUOTE(#{resource}), '$')
select question_id from biz_practical_question_material where resource_path = #{resource} and material_type = 'REFERENCE' order by question_id desc limit 1

select question_id from ( select question_id from biz_question where file_path = #{resource} or preview_path = #{resource} union all select question_id from biz_practical_question_material where resource_path = #{resource} and material_type != 'REFERENCE' ) question_resource order by question_id desc limit 1

select application.teacher_id as teacherId, application.dept_id as deptId from biz_exemption_attachment attachment inner join biz_exemption_application application on application.application_id = attachment.application_id where attachment.resource_path = #{resource} limit 1

select count(1) from biz_student s inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id inner join biz_lesson_assignment a on a.entry_year = s.entry_year and a.class_code = s.class_code and a.dept_id = u.dept_id inner join biz_lesson_question lq on lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id and lq.question_id = #{questionId} where s.student_id = #{studentId}
select count(1) from biz_county_exam_paper_question pq where pq.student_id = #{studentId} and (pq.file_path = #{resource} or pq.preview_path = #{resource})

select count(1) from biz_county_exam_paper_question pq inner join biz_county_exam_answer a on a.exam_id = pq.exam_id and a.student_id = pq.student_id and a.question_id = pq.question_id inner join biz_county_exam e on e.exam_id = a.exam_id where a.grader_id = #{graderId} and e.status = '2' and ifnull(e.grading_enabled, '0') = '1' and e.del_flag = '0' and (pq.file_path = #{resource} or pq.preview_path = #{resource})

select count(1) from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam e on e.exam_id = a.exam_id where a.answer_id = #{answerId} and a.grader_id = #{graderId} and e.status = '2' and ifnull(e.grading_enabled, '0') = '1' and e.del_flag = '0'
